question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What quality is most important for someone you'd date in real life?
Would you (or did you) play this pack more than once?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Try this on for size...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: HAY-YAH!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Oof...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Travis went down like an old building hit by an earthquake.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey! Get back here and fight like a man!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: But I couldn't do it... I couldn't fight him.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: But I took one step forward and put up my fists...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Sure enough, Travis was waiting in the parking lot for me after school.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I can't believe you actually showed up.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: This is going to be fun...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Everything inside me screamed that I should turn and run...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Sorry man, but I can't give up this seat.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Wh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: See... If I gave up this seat today, then you'd probably want it again tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: And if I gave it up again tomorrow, you'd probably want it the next day.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: And I really don't want to go all the way through high school having to move chairs every day.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: So `no`, you can't have the seat.
nodes.text_bbcode: So [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color], you can't have the seat.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Fine... Have it your way.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Parking lot. After school. Be there.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: AH-HEM!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: S... Sophie?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I... Uh... Didn't see you there.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Apparently not.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Otherwise, I'm sure you wouldn't have been bothering my new friend Matt.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: S... Sorry, Matt. I... I didn't know you were with her.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I'll, uh, see you later, okay?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: That was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: But... Why was he so scared of you?

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Hehe. Let's just say you don't want to get on my bad side.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I guess not...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Don't worry though... You're `definitely` on my good side.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry though... You're [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] on my good side.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Uh sure... I'll get up. No problem.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Thanks, champ. You're a real sweetheart.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing in `my` seat?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you think you're doing in [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] seat?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Dude. There's an empty one right over there.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yeah. But I want `that` one.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. But I want [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] one.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I'd known guys like him at my old school...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I'd even tried to fight a couple of them... And lost every time.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: But this was a new school, right?

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I decided I'd...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Uh... Hey.

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I'm Matt.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: I'm Holly.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Holly and I ended up being in a bunch of the same classes.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: She was new to the school too, and neither of us knew anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: We pretty much just talked to each other.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: ...I can't believe you don't know the difference between a skirt and a dress!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Uh... It's not like I wear either of them...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: And my mom always wears jeans.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Hehe. What a nerd...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Hey! Take that back.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Make me.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I could barely believe my luck... My first week at a brand-new school, and I was already friends with this beautiful girl...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And then `he` came along...
nodes.text_bbcode: And then [color=#e23b3b][i]he[/i][/color] came along...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Uh... Hey.

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I'm Matt.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: I'm Sophie.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Sophie and I didn't have all that much in common...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I was brand-new to town, and she'd lived here all her life.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: She'd had the same friends since pre-school... I didn't know anyone.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: But for some reason, it seemed like she liked me.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I don't know... Are you really sure you want to be seen with me at the party tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: ...Aw... Don't say that! My friends are totally going to love you!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I dunno... I just get nervous talking with new people.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Well... You came up and talked to me.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Trust me. It'll be fun!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Everything seemed to be going perfectly... My first week at a new school, and I was already friends with this beautiful girl...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And then `he` came along...
nodes.text_bbcode: And then [color=#e23b3b][i]he[/i][/color] came along...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I froze. Total panic.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I just stood there, looking stupid, as the girls walked away.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: For those first few days of school, I turned into the kind of lonely loser I always feared I'd become.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: It was like I was just waiting for someone to come and put me out of my misery.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And then, sure enough, `he` came along...
nodes.text_bbcode: And then, sure enough, [color=#e23b3b][i]he[/i][/color] came along...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I'm going to give you until the count of three.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: One...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Two...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Fine. You win. You really are as big of a jerk as you pretend to be.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: I thought I spotted a glimmer of kindness under there... But I guess I was just seeing things.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Cool! But wait a minute... Aren't you worried the heads will try to eat each other?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I never thought of that...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: It's okay... Here. Just make sure they're a little farther apart...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: She took the wood and sanded it a little...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Hey... You're right. That looks way cooler!

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Huh... So you `can` actually listen to people when you want to, huh?
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh... So you [color=#3b78e2][i]can[/i][/color] actually listen to people when you want to, huh?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Maybe you're not as totally evil as people think...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I'd never met anyone like her... Alison just totally accepted me for who I was.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: That night, we went out to pizza for our first date...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: We started hanging out all the time...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: When I look back, I'm not exactly sure how I stopped being a bully...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I guess, hanging around her, I eventually just sort of forgot I was one...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: The year was coming to an end... And for the first time, I was in love...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Oh... I thought it was something cooler...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Like a two-headed zombie or something.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Well... See ya.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I sometimes wonder what might have happened if I'd just been honest with her...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: But it probably wouldn't have made a difference...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Ha! I knew it... You do have a heart!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: No... No I don't!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I just don't want to punch you and mess up your pretty face!

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Aw... You think I'm pretty!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: N... No I don't!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I... Er... I... Have to go... Wash my... Socks?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: See you around, Matt...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: The next time I saw Alison was in woodshop...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I was making a wooden statue of a two-headed zombie on the band saw.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Hey, Matt!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Don't startle me like that!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I don't want to end up as a woodshop horror story.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Whatcha making?

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I worked out the whole summer before sophomore year.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: By the time school started, I'd put on twenty pounds of muscle.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And I was more than happy to show it off to anyone who got in my way.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: A lot of people say that bullies are just misunderstood...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: That if you really could dig beneath that brutish exterior, you'd see a tender soul...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: What a joke.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I stomped nerds, pantsed goth kids, and shoved freshmen into lockers...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And I loved every minute of it.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: What's your problem, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: It was Alison, a weird goth girl I'd met in woodshop.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Problem? There's no problem here.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: I saw what you just did... I guess you think you're pretty tough, pushing poor Spud around?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Maybe I do...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: I'll see how tough you are...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: She punched me. Right in the stomach!

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: So what now... You going to push me around, too?

nodes.prompt: You going to push me around, too?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You going to push me around, too?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Charge!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I ran at Travis...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And bounced right off of his back.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Did you just try to hit me?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: That's hilarious... I almost `felt` that!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's hilarious... I almost [color=#e23b3b][i]felt[/i][/color] that!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Now listen here and listen good...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You were born a loser, and you're always going to be a loser...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: So you might as well get used to it.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And for the next year at least, Travis was right...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Hey, Spud! Duck behind his legs!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I shoved Travis...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And he fell over Spud's back!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: High Five!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: High Five!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Grrr... You're dead meat.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: You want to fight... You're going to have to fight both of us.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Make that all three of us!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: F... Forget this. I'm out of here!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: We did it!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Thanks for everything, Alison.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Hey, what can I say? We goths and nerds need to stick together, right?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Definitely.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: So maybe we should get together... On a date sometime?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: You... You want to go out with me?!

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Yup. And don't look so surprised!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Heh. Okay.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I hoped I'd have another opportunity to show Travis he couldn't push me around...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And as luck would have it, I got my chance the next day.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey, Spud. Here's a joke for ya. What does a dog do when it's tired?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Uh... I dunno.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: It... `PANTS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It... [color=#e23b3b][i]PANTS![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Travis pantses Spud!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Nice `Ogres and Elves` underwear.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres and Elves[/i][/color] underwear.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I've got to play this smart if I want to take Travis down...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Great! I'll see you then, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Why do you let him treat you like that?

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: It was Alison, a gothy girl I'd talked to a few times in art class...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I had the chance to stand up to him once... And I messed it up.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: So... Why not try again?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: You just don't get it...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Maybe I don't...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: It sounds like you've got a lot of work to do.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Wrong answer.
SMASH!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Ow... Ow...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You might want to actually `think` before you talk next time.
nodes.text_bbcode: You might want to actually [color=#e23b3b][i]think[/i][/color] before you talk next time.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Just a piece of free advice.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Hey... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: It was Alison, a gothy girl I'd talked to a few times in art class...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I've actually gotten pretty good at taking a punch lately.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Hehe. Well, I'm glad you're standing up to him... Even if it means you get knocked down.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: My dad always says, 'Get knocked down seven times... Stand up eight.'

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Wait... Does that really add up?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I dunno... The point is, you keep fighting, right?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Right.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I kind of let myself go after I broke up with Sophie...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I felt like a loser... And I guess I looked like one too.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Oh... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: I thought maybe you wanted someone to talk to...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: But I can tell you'd rather be alone...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I sometimes wonder what might have happened if I'd talked to her...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: But as it was, it ended up being a long, lonely year...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: I take it you finally found out about Holly and Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: 'Finally'?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah. She's been hooking up with him for a while now. And Hector... And Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I guess I never did really know Holly as well as I thought...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Matt...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: I've seen how it's been with you and Holly...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: You've always been really sweet with her...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: And she never seemed to care.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I guess you have a point...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: You know... You should be with someone who can appreciate you.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Like who?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Well... Like me.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Smooch.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: It was just that simple... From then on, Alison and I were together.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Two weeks later, I got separated from Holly at a house party.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I looked for her everywhere...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Finally, I thought to look for her in one of the bedrooms...

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Smooch, smooch.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Smooch, smooch.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Holly!

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Oh... Billy Bob, it's you.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: My name is Matt!

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Matt, sweetie... Could you please give me and Ryan some privacy?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: But... But I'm your boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Not anymore, hon. It was nice while it lasted, but I'm moving on now.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: You... You're dumping me for this guy?

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Sorry, Matt...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I took off and ran out of the house...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: It was cold outside, and I'd never felt worse.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, but I actually started tearing up...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Hey... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Oh... Are you... Crying?

options.label: I got something in my eye.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Sorry about that... I guess Holly is just so beautiful, I forget about her other good qualities.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Oh... Like what?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Well... She's a really good dancer... And a good kisser...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: And... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Hey... Don't worry about it. I was just teasing you anyway.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: I just hope she's a good girlfriend to you... You seem like a sweet guy.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Uh... I should probably... Go.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: What was that all about?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: So... You'd never date a girl that wasn't totally hot?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I mean... Why would I date someone who I'm not attracted to?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Well... That's a good point...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: But maybe there are certain girls that are cute without being traditionally 'hot', right?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Hmm... I guess... Theoretically.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: You know what... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: You and Holly deserve each other.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: What was that all about?

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I guess it shouldn't be surprising, but Holly turned out to be super popular.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Not that I minded... Her friends ended up being my friends, too.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: 'Sup Ryan? 'Sup Alison?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `Great` to see you as always, Alison... And you too, Steve.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Great[/i][/color] to see you as always, Alison... And you too, Steve.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Uh... My name is Matt.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Okay... So they weren't `that` good of friends with me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay... So they weren't [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] good of friends with me...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, Holly, you ready to head to the gym?

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Yup. And I just got some new shorts!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: In that case, let's get to the gym ASAP!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: See you later, Jimbo.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: 'Jimbo'?!

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: You know, Holly's pretty lucky to have a guy as patient as you dating her...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I never thought I'd be able to land a girl as hot as Holly...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: You know... Looks aren't everything...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Oh... I mean... Uh...

options.label: This is high school, not marriage. Looks are where it's at.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Yeah! It's so fun dancing with you!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: What can I say? It wasn't love, but we had fun together...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: It was high school... What more was I expecting, right?

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I said... I love you.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Matt...

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: We're just having fun here...

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: You know that, right?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: We went back to dancing...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: But things were just never the same after that...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Dating Holly turned out to be a lot of fun...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: We hung out constantly over the next year...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: She was an awesome dancer, and we went out to this under-18 club almost every weekend.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: I love this song.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I... I love...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Look. Sophie... We need to talk.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I'm starting to feel more like your business associate than your boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Oh... Sweetie... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: I guess I've just wanted so much for you to succeed...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: But... I guess maybe we should take a second to celebrate your win.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: So... Come here.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Hey! That's going to leave a mark!

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Hehe. Good. Now you'll have to finally wear that collared shirt I bought you.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Trust me, it's worth it.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I guess... We should get to work on that presentation.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Once we're done with that, we can get to work on your wardrobe.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: That black T-shirt might fly out here in the sticks, but you'll need something nicer to get to the next level.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Hmm... And your nails are a little nubby... You might need a manicure.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: A... Manicure? But I'm a... Man.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: And now you'll be a decently groomed man!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I'm so lucky to have you for a girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: If I didn't have you to keep track of everything, I'd probably be stuck doing oil changes like my dad for the rest of my life...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Well... I'm just glad you appreciate me.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Smooch!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: The funny thing is, Sophie was right about me...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: With a little confidence, I kicked Business Champion butt!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Congratulations, Matt... Your StrongPoint presentation blew the other team out of the water!

nodes.text: Okay... So you remember your schedule for tomorrow, right?

nodes.text: You've got your 'Future Important Business Champions of America' meeting right after school...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: And then you're working at 'Pizza My Mind' from five to nine.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: And don't forget to ask for that promotion.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: And then you can come over here for a late dinner right after!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I remember thinking...

options.label: Sophie is way too high maintenance.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I had no girl... And worst of all, no dignity.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Little did I know, I was just beginning my journey to becoming a `total loser.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Little did I know, I was just beginning my journey to becoming a [color=#e23b3b][i]total loser.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Excellent. Now, I take it this seat isn't taken, Miss?

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Not anymore.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Holly...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I can look back and see it now...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: That's the moment that I lost Holly...

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Wow! I can't believe you stood up to him!

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: That guy was like twice your size.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Well, you know, it's not the size of the dog in the fight...

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: It's the size of the fight in the dog!

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Come on. Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: You can walk me home.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: And that was that... From there on, Holly and I were together...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Matt... What's wrong with you? Why'd you beat him up?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I... I had to. He told me to move chairs!

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: I thought you were a nice guy...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Now I see you're just a thug like all the rest of the guys at this stupid school...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I'll always wonder what might have happened if I'd just walked away from that fight...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: But I guess I'll never know...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: W... Wow!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: You just took down Travis!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I... I guess that means you're the toughest guy at school now!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: He was right...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: From that day forward, I became Centerscore High's meanest bully.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Wow... You really scared him.

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: That was `so` hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hot!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Thanks. Want to make out?

nodes.speaker: Holly
nodes.text: Definitely!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: That was it for me and Holly... She'd seen my true colors.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: After that, news that I'd run away spread all over school...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Before too long, everyone there knew I was a complete loser...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: You just made a big mistake, Travis...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: S... Sophie?

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Matt happens to be a friend of mine...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: I'm just glad he was gentleman enough not to fight...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: As for you, Travis...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: You'll never date a hot girl at this school again.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Eventually, Sophie tracked me down and told me she'd put Travis in his place...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I couldn't believe it... She actually said she was `proud` of me for not fighting.
nodes.text_bbcode: I couldn't believe it... She actually said she was [color=#e23b3b][i]proud[/i][/color] of me for not fighting.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: But I guess that was the kind of girl Sophie was...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Maybe that's why I fell for her as hard as I did...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: It's funny how life works...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Every day, we make a hundred choices...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Do I head this way...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Or that way?

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Do I head into school...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Or skip out and go to the beach?

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Thinking back on high school now, I can see that I ended up where I am based on a few truly important decisions...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: That's what I want to tell you about... That handful of choices that molded me into the person I am today.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Naturally, it all started with a girl...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: It was my first day of high school...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I'd just walked in the door when I found myself between two of the cutest girls I'd ever seen.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: To my left was a pretty blonde girl... On my right, a classy-looking brunette.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I made up my mind to talk to one of them...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I decided to talk with...

nodes.prompt: To my left was a pretty blonde girl. On my right, a classy-looking brunette.

nodes.title: Sophomore year
nodes.subtitle: I was a high school loser...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: With my girlfriends, Paula and Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks for taking me to Prom, Matt... But couldn't you have dressed up a little?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Actually, he's taking `me` to Prom... And Matt can wear whatever he wants!
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, he's taking [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] to Prom... And Matt can wear whatever he wants!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Girls, girls... I'm dating both of you. And I'll wear whatever clothes I want.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: That's it... I'm tired of Taylor butting in on `our` dates!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it... I'm tired of Taylor butting in on [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] dates!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Them's fightin' words!
Taylor lunges past Matt toward Paula.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You want a piece of me, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Honey, I don't want a piece... I want the whole thing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Take this!
The girls fall to the floor, tearing at each others' hair.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I used to think this was hot...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: But they kind of do this every day.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Oh... Are Paula and Taylor fighting again?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Ow! You ripped off my fake eyelash!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey! Watch the face! My nose is still broken from last week!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Looks like it.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Huh... You want to go get some fruit punch?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Yeah... This fight could take all night.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I mean... What can I say? I made my choices.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: And this is where I ended up...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: It's not a bad life by any means...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Still, I sometimes wonder what things might have been like if I'd taken a different path...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: With the love of my life, Sophie!

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Matt! There you are!

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: I'm `so` tired from carrying my purse around all night...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] tired from carrying my purse around all night...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Would you mind holding it for me?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Y... Yes, dear.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Thanks! Oh, and there's the punch. Go get me a cup. And don't forget to vote for me for Prom Queen on your way back.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Yes, dear...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: So... This is what my life has come to...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I have to carry a purse and fetch punch...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: But at least I have a smoking-hot girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: And I'm going to a really awesome college, thanks to my academic success!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I'm a `success`, I tell you. A `big success!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm a [color=#e23b3b][i]success[/i][/color], I tell you. A [color=#e23b3b][i]big success![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Oh Maaa-aaaatt! I'm getting thirsty.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Here you go, my treasure.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Thank you... And one other thing...

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Were you just talking to yourself again as you walked across the room?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I... I guess I was.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: What have I told you about acting like an insane person in public?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I guess you said... Not to.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: You know... I sometimes don't know how I've put up with you for all these years.

nodes.speaker: Sophie
nodes.text: Now, come on. Let's go see if those Tango lessons I made you take have paid off.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: With Alison!

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Guten Abend, meine Liebe!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Hehe. You know I love it when you speak German to me!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Would you care to dance?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Ja!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: You don't know how nice it is to finally have you back.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Aw... Was it really so hard, being apart?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I mean... I survived, right?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Well... I'm glad you said that...

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Because I'm putting off college to backpack through Asia next year!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Wh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: HAHAHA!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: You... You're kidding?

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Yep. Come on, sweetie... I don't like being apart from you either.

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: And I'm so happy we're going to the same college next year!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: So that's how our story ends...

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I survived high school... And even got the girl!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Smooch!

nodes.speaker: Alison
nodes.text: Smooch!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: I guess you could say things worked out pretty well...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: All by myself...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I guess it wouldn't be `so` bad, except that everyone else seems so happy...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess it wouldn't be [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] bad, except that everyone else seems so happy...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Why... Why doesn't anyone like me?!

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Sniffle.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Aw, quit feeling sorry for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Boo hoo!
SMACK!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: There. Now you have something to cry about.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I mean, high school is over, and I'm here... I survived.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: But what if just surviving isn't enough?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Did things really have to end up like this... With me at prom all alone?

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: I guess the point is, I just made too many bad choices along the way...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Not that there's any way to go back in time, to 're-play' the past...

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Still... I sometimes wonder... What might have happened if I'd only done things a little differently...
